user.title: Genbu Assistant
user.description: Genbu keeps your Genbu Shows on one version. One of them, the main update Show, looks for updates and asks about them; the others follow the version it runs. Shows found: {count}.

data_description.main_show: Leave it empty to pick later in select.genbu_main_update_show.

abort.already_configured: Genbu Assistant is set up already
abort.single_instance_allowed: Genbu Assistant is set up already

init.title: Genbu Assistant
init.description: {main} is the main update Show. Change it in select.genbu_main_update_show.

data_description.extra_mains: One is usually enough. With more, the other Shows follow whichever of them runs the newest version.
data_description.notify_service: A notify service, like mobile_app_my_phone. It gets a push when a main update Show has been offline for a day.

second.title: A second main update Show?
second.description: {main} is already the main update Show. With two, the other Shows follow whichever of them is newer. They cannot fight, but you get two Shows that ask about updates.

init.title: {name} is offline
init.description: Home Assistant has not seen {name} since {since}. The other Shows stay on their version until there is a main update Show again. If nobody answers, Genbu makes {pick} the main update Show on {pick_at}.

menu_options.pick: Pick a new main update Show

pick.title: New main update Show
pick.description: Your Shows are on {version}. The recommended Show is online and closest to it.

abort.none_online: No Genbu Show is online right now. Try again when one is.

pick.title: New main update Show
pick.description: Your Shows are on {version}. The recommended Show is online and closest to it.

abort.none_online: No Genbu Show is online right now. Try again when one is.

main_picked.title: {new} is now the main update Show

confirm.title: {new} is now the main update Show
confirm.description: {gone} was offline for 7 days and nobody answered, so Genbu made {new} the main update Show. The version your Shows are on did not change. To change it, use {select}.

main_dropped.title: {gone} is no main update Show any more

confirm.title: {gone} is no main update Show any more
confirm.description: {gone} was offline for 7 days and nobody answered. The other main update Show carries on. To change it, use {select}.

forget_show.name: Forget a Show
forget_show.description: Forgets a Show that has left the house for good: it stops being a main update Show (when it was the only one, the recommended Show takes over) and its versions and music choice are dropped. The installer's --remove-show calls this after the Show is out of ESPHome.

node.name: Node name
node.description: The Show's ESPHome node name, as in main_shows on the house version sensor.

install_updates.name: Install updates on every Show
install_updates.description: Every Show with an update waiting installs it. A Show calls this when somebody says yes to its update, so the whole house updates even when that Show has none itself; the voice kit's "install the updates" calls it too.

except_node.name: Except node
except_node.description: The ESPHome node name of a Show to leave out, because it is installing already.
